nodes.label: W-249 — the store carries its own governance at last
nodes.rationale: Seventy-one members seated: five ruling documents, SETTLED-R4.tsv, twenty-five findings, three account documents and thirty-seven instruments.

nodes.label: A governing document the store does not carry does not hold
nodes.rationale: RULINGS-R4b through R4f existed only as working files, so a chat opening by the §0 gate could not see the rulings under which nine builds had been made. The findings are seated too — including the withdrawn ones, because a withdrawal that leaves no trace is not a record.

nodes.label: The method/proofs goldens are deliberately not seated
nodes.rationale: gate_live.py enrols every NAME.out in members/ and gate.py runs each as python3 NAME.py from members/ with a 270-second ceiling; seating them would enrol twenty-four instruments not written to run in the live walk and turn the gate red for a reason that is not a fault in the store. Each keeps its --selftest instead.
